truths.truth: A staged value containing ", <, & or ' lands in hqplayerd.xml as entity text and reads back as the original value
truths.evidence: hqptuner/conf/xmledit.py:179-193 attr_escape/attr_unescape; set_attr (xmledit.py:212) escapes, get_attr (xmledit.py:207) unescapes; presetconf._route (presetconf.py:211-220) writes every field through edit_element/edit_plugin, net_device included; fixedvol.py:118,131-134 and matrixconf.py:88 escape level and process. Spot-check: apply_edits on title 'a"b<c>d&e'f &' wrote value="a"b<c>d&e'f &amp;" and both read_config and minidom read back the original (True, True). Bite: the pre-2665a322 set_attr, exec'd from git show, turned 'x"/><foo bar="baz' into '<title value="x"/><foo bar="baz"/>'. tests/engine/http/test_xml_escaping.py passes.

truths.truth: A Control API command with &, < or ' in a value is sent unchanged; one with " is refused before any byte is written
truths.evidence: hqptuner/engine/control.py:334-345 ControlClient.send refuses a value holding '"' with AttributeValueRefusedError (controlerrors.py, code invalid_input) before request(); otherwise interpolates raw. The only other interpolated request (control.py:327) carries a command name, not a value. tests/engine/http/test_control_attr_quote.py (ampersand/apostrophe/angle-bracket unchanged on the wire; quote refused; next command the only one written) passes against a recording fake that parses nothing.

truths.truth: A staged matrix_enabled of on, or any value not among its page's choices, is refused at /api/config/stage and /api/config/live with nothing written
truths.evidence: presetconf.check_choices (presetconf.py:400-421) reads choices from readings.config_form/matrix_form; pending.check_offered (pending.py) answers 503/502 via deps.ensure_form when the page is unloaded; stage() (pending.py) refuses before store.stage; config_live (apply.py:163-168) refuses before _stand_autopilot_down and lane.apply_now. tests/api/surface/test_staged_choices.py (flag spelled on refused, buffer unchanged, apply after refusal sends no restore, unloaded page answers not_loaded, held value refused at live and not held, engine sent nothing extra) and tests/engine/http/test_page_choices.py pass.

truths.truth: A 401 following a normal answer in the same apply is reported as an engine fault and credentials_ok is unchanged
truths.evidence: httpconf.py HttpConfigClient.answered counter incremented on each 2xx in _mark, retract_refusal(); lanes/http/restore.py apply() snapshots answered and readings.credentials_ok at start and on AuthRefused after an answer retracts the verdict, restores readings.credentials_ok and raises RestoreRefusedAfterAnswerError (daemon_write_failed). tests/engine/http/test_engine_fault_after_answer.py: code daemon_write_failed, credentials_ok True after, and still True after the next poll with the lane down - all pass.

truths.truth: A restore upload over its ceiling, a member whose declared decompressed size is over its ceiling, and a member name that is absolute, contains .. or a backslash are each refused with nothing sent to the daemon
truths.evidence: routes/config.py _read_upload checks UploadFile.size then read(limit+1) against presetzip.RESTORE_UPLOAD_CEILING; _refuse_unfit_archive runs presetzip.check_sizes (declared file_size vs MEMBER_CEILING 64 MiB / TOTAL_CEILING 128 MiB) and check_names (presetzip.py:254-273: leading /, '..', backslash, drive prefix, root members other than the working config, hqplayerd-auth.xml) before take_descriptions and settle.restore. First-connect snapshot_members carries the same size check (762e8034). tests/api/surface/test_restore_limits.py and test_restore_members.py (_BAD_NAMES = /etc/x, data/../x, data\x, C:x.xml, hqplayerd-auth.xml, run.sh; each with a no-restore-sent case) and tests/engine/http/test_snapshot_member_ceiling.py pass. Residual recorded in PLAN-2.md:83: Starlette spools the upload to disk before the route's ceiling applies.

truths.truth: An over-limit description entry in an accepted archive is dropped and the other entries merge
truths.evidence: presets/store/descriptions.py _storable runs _validate_name and _validate_text per carried entry, logs and drops a failure; merge() uses it. tests/api/surface/test_restore_descriptions.py (text-too-long, control, name-long dropped; valid entry merges) passes.

truths.truth: A staged value over the length ceiling is refused
truths.evidence: pending.py MAX_VALUE_LENGTH 262144, MAX_STAGED_KEYS 256; refuse_long_values called first in stage() and in config_live (apply.py:163); key ceiling counted on the merged buffer in stage(). tests/api/surface/test_stage_ceiling.py (1 MiB value at stage and at live, live argument, 10000 keys, flood in small requests, realistic 128-row matrix still stages, refused live value sends no setter) passes.

truths.truth: /api/audit with a limit over its cap answers at most the cap
truths.evidence: hqptuner/api/routes/audit.py MAX_LIMIT = 1000, audit.tail(min(limit, MAX_LIMIT)); pre-fix (git show 6419c0dc^) was audit.tail(limit). tests/audit/test_audit_limit_cap.py::test_a_limit_far_above_the_cap_answers_exactly_the_cap passes.

truths.truth: A profile switch naming a profile absent from a fresh MatrixListProfiles read is refused and no switch command is sent
truths.evidence: lanes/matrixlane.py switch_profile: a non-empty name not in await client.get_matrix_profiles() raises UnknownProfileError (invalid_input) before client.set_matrix_profile (matrixlane.py:57); routes/matrix/matrix.py:189-193 maps it to a refusal. switch_profile is the only caller of set_matrix_profile. Pre-fix matrixlane.py had no get_matrix_profiles call. tests/matrix/test_profile_switch_known.py (refused, no switch sent, listed name with spaces switches, empty name switches to default) passes.

truths.truth: A preset, snapshot or mode name resolving outside its store is refused on every platform; under the Windows build a:b and CON are refused while on Linux a:b saves
truths.evidence: presets/store/presets.py _path resolves store and file and refuses via names.lies_inside with OUTSIDE_STORE; snapshot (live.py:234-263) and mode (matrixmode.py:148-173) stores are single JSON files keyed by name, so no name reaches a path; shared rule (names.py:85-93) already refuses separators and '..'. names.validate_stored_name adds the win32 colon and device-name checks at PresetStore.save/import_missing, LivePresetStore.save, MatrixModeStore.write, defaulting to sys.platform. tests/api/surface/test_preset_name_reach.py (win32 refusals incl. a:b, CON, NUL.txt, LPT superscript; Linux accepts a:b and CON; Linux save of a:b reads back over HTTP; symlink-out read and save refused) passes.
